## Foods & dishes
- [[Food.com Recipes and Interactions]]: 255 recipes tagged `cuban` (ingredients without amounts, steps, nutrition; often Cuban-American).
- [[RecipeDB2]]: ≈540 recipes in v1 (Caribbean region 3,026); not released.
- Dish inventories: [[WorldCuisines]] 23 dishes (3 Cuba-only, e.g. arroz con maíz; `Cuban` label 5); [[FmLAMA]] 2 (medianoche, Elena Ruz).
- Backlog: [[RecetasDeLaAbuela]] (priority 3, open-download): Spanish-language recipes labelled by Spanish-speaking country; per-country counts not known yet.

## Ingredients & food composition
- No national food composition table in the vault or `Backlog/`; [[USDA FoodData Central]] is the fallback.
- Plants: [[CMAUP]] 168 plants; [[NPASS]] 6 specimen pairs.

## Compounds & traditional medicine
- [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]]: 112 ethnobotany records, 65 taxa. [[KNApSAcK Family]] has a World-map page for it (edible/medicinal species records), not scraped, so no count in the vault.
- Compound → effect chains via the [[Global]] backbones ([[FooDB]], [[CTD]], [[Phenol-Explorer]], [[SpiceRx]]).

## Gaps
- No Cuban FCT; recipe coverage is diaspora-biased (US uploaders).
